task.title: Set-picker engagement polish: pointerenter hair-trigger, collapse-engages, focus-fetch-then-retype, per-item scroll effect cost
task.description:
Residue from P6-137 round-2 review (2026-08-12), all minor/lazy-path:

1. rail.rs ~:1064 — on:pointerenter engages with no dwell/intent delay: on a ?q=s: URL an incidental mouse pass over the visible sidebar picker costs the full ~1,047-row fetch + mount. Consider a small dwell (150-250ms) or dropping pointerenter in favor of focus/click only.
2. rail.rs ~:944 — closing an auto-opened section also engages (click-to-collapse fetches and mounts 1,047 rows into a hidden details). Gate engagement on transitions INTO open.
3. rail.rs ~:1063 — engaging by focus fetches the whole catalog before the user types; the debounce then re-keys and remounts. One wasted full mount per type-to-search session — consider deferring the fetch to the later of (engaged, first debounce settle).
4. command.rs ~:448-460 — the scroll-into-view addition costs one Effect + one NodeRef per item (1,047 each, two runs at mount); the ~840ms mount figure in specs/app-ui.md:2104 predates it and was not re-measured. Re-measure and note.
5. rail.rs ~:943-947 — a toggle landing between hydration and the effect's first queued run is swallowed (section opens un-engaged until another interaction). Self-healing, very narrow; note only.

Related: WB-01KZVTASXR (Command primitive perf polish + SheetContent mounting).
